doc.title: Allan Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000

title: Piano lessons as a child
summary: He and his brother took piano lessons because their father insisted.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Do you have experience with the piano?

Yeah. I started on piano. Both my brother and I took piano lessons when we were kids. My father insisted on it. And it’s the one thing that he really did for us — he insisted, no matter what we played he said it would give you a basis of understanding the music. My brother actually plays better piano than I do because he kept on practicing. I never did.
